caption: The image depicts a rectangular wooden coffee grinder with visible dovetail joints at the corners. Near the bottom of the grinder, there is a pull-out wooden drawer with a small round black knob, designed to catch the ground coffee. The background is plain and uncolored, which isolates the object and draws focus to its details.
